data.body: Root cause confirmed by deterministic reproduction: manifest.py:497 stamps gate_code_version() per call; it shells git status --porcelain, so a concurrent worker touching the checkout flips -dirty between two build_manifest calls in one test. Fix: monkeypatch rebar.signing.gate_code_version in test_manifest_file_scope_contract_preserves_legacy_bytes and test_manifest_is_deterministic_and_path_independent (the pattern test_no_pins_preserves_legacy_manifest_bytes already uses). Verified: pinned equality survives an interleaved dirtying; repo grep shows all manifest byte-equality sites now pinned. Gerrit change 2088.
